fixes.new:
A pilot of the $$ジェニオン$$.
After boarding the $$ジェニオン$$ by chance encounter, he became its test pilot, both at the request of $$ＡＧ$$ of the $$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$ and for his own purposes. That purpose is to track down the mysterious being known as '$$テンシ$$' that appeared during the dimensional tremor that took the lives of his father and sister, and he is thinking of using the $$ジェニオン$$ as the power to do it.
As proof of contact with $$テンシ$$, a phenomenon called the $$血塗られた眼$$ has developed in only one of his eyes, and he suffers from the pain and fear that come with it.
Due to past circumstances, he had carried himself with a curt, cool air, but through his interactions with his friends he is striving to change that.
Before coming to $$第２新東京市$$, he worked as a $$ビーストハンター$$ (exterminating vermin that had strayed in from other parallel worlds) alongside his father, a retired soldier, and has honed field skills and survival ability to match. He also learned Jeet Kune Do from his movie-loving father.
He also investigated various occult phenomena in order to track down '$$テンシ$$,' and was a regular contributor to a certain research site online.
Through his ties with friends and comrades, he grows both as a fighter and as a person. Through the Volunteer Club's activities, he even discovers the simple joy of picking up litter.
He also begins seeing $$柏葉真紀$$, a nurse he met while visiting someone who also had the $$血塗られた眼$$, though he keeps it vague that he fights in the $$ジェニオン$$.
After defeating $$ガドライト#pilot$$, who took his family from him, and destroying the $$時の牢獄$$, he resolves to keep fighting to protect what he can, in whatever way is his to give.
fixes.reason: omission: the Japanese says he is thinking of using the Genion as that power (kangaete iru); the English dropped the verb and read as a fact

fixes.new:
A student teacher assigned to $$陣代高校$$.
Her subject is Modern Japanese.
She was one of the special student teachers being trialed in $$第２新東京市$$, a city built around research and academia, and though still a university student, spent a full year at her assigned school, $$陣代高校$$.
Since the school already has several teachers with the surname Saijou, she is known simply as Ms. $$スズネ$$.
Caring and easy to get along with, she is well liked by the students, and enjoys overwhelming popularity among some of the boys in particular.
She also has an interest in occult research as a hobby, and is a regular contributor to a certain research site online.
After learning the situation her students were in, she came to understand them, and resolved to become a sub-pilot of the $$ジェニオン$$ herself in order to protect their lives as students at the same time. When aboard the $$ジェニオン$$, she handles navigation and output adjustment, and struggles alongside her students despite her inexperience.
At the same time, she serves as faculty advisor for the Volunteer Club, formed to protect their everyday lives. She goes along with the audacious scheme of treating her students' absences as extracurricular activity under her own supervision, so their time away counts as attendance.
She herself was transported alone into this world by a translocation several years ago, and has no family. Perhaps because she has spent her life absorbed in her studies, she also has no particular man she is seeing, and privately, this weighs on her mind.
fixes.reason: addition: the Japanese says only that she has no family (kazoku wa inai); 'here' is not in the text

fixes.new:
An agent robot of the $$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$, an enterprise group that operates across parallel worlds. Its name is short for 'AGENT.'
It fell to Earth caught up in a dimensional tremor together with the $$ジェニオン$$, and since then has overseen the $$ジェニオン$$'s field tests for the purpose of gathering data.
It also runs the dimensional shop '$$Ｄトレーダー$$,' stocked through its own private supply routes, and personally serves as its guide.
A flippant sort, it shows more rich emotion than one would expect from a robot, and often stirs up trouble around it. At the same time, it is sensitive to other people's subtle feelings, and can be surprisingly caring, offering advice that delves into their inner feelings.
After the $$時の牢獄$$ was destroyed, it considered returning to $$ＤＥＭ$$ together with the $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$, which had reached a provisional completion.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: the Japanese says the advice steps into other people's inner feelings (sono naimen ni fumikonda); 'cuts right to the heart of a matter' turns it into problem-solving advice

Former Foreign Minister of the Republic of $$リモネシア$$.
Since the $$カラミティ・バース$$ that occurred during the $$破界事変$$, she stood at the head of politics as chief political officer of the $$新帝国インペリウム$$.
At the time of serving as Foreign Minister of $$リモネシア$$, she was an elite who shouldered the nation at a young age, and in a world effectively ruled by the great powers, ran about wishing for the peace and prosperity of the homeland.
Being of a delicate temperament to begin with, she felt great stress under the weight of responsibility, a sense of mission, and love for the homeland, and for that reason joined $$プロジェクト・ウズメ$$ in an attempt to raise the standing of $$リモネシア$$. However, that balance was completely shattered by the collapse of $$リモネシア$$; the rebound from the stress swelled desire and ego, and she transformed into a paper-tiger dictator who borrowed the authority of $$ガイオウ$$ and $$アイム#pilot$$.
She was defeated in the decisive battle at $$陰月$$ during the $$破界事変$$, and her ambitions came to nothing.

Though defeated in the battle at the $$ラース・バビロン$$ defense line, he tenaciously survived, and later led the remnants of $$サイデリアル$$ to take part in the fights against $$バアル$$ and the $$御使い$$s.
